mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals active monetary easing, reducing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decline fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or correlation p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month increases in housing starts and retail sales signal robust consumer demand, boosting corporate revenues and stock valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint condition of HOUST and RSAFS > 0.5% MoM fails to produce positive 60-day returns in >60% of cases, or interaction term p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production signals impending economic slowdown, reducing corporate investment and earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline fails to produce negative 20-day returns in >60% of late-cycle expansion instances, or effect p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt central bank tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY, or correlation p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Strong month-over-month non-farm payrolls growth indicates healthy labor market conditions supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive 5-day returns occur in <55% of instances when PAYEMS growth is positive, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly real GDP growth exceeding 1.0% signals sustained economic expansion that boosts corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive 60-day returns occur in <55% of instances when GDPC1 growth is positive, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100.0 (2017 base index) indicates significant manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate investment and earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or effect p-value > 0.05.
